dialogues.speaker: Lietzberg
dialogues.text: Oh, hi! Looking to buy something?

dialogues.speaker: Lietzberg
dialogues.text: I only meant to stop by and buy a few carrots for Sticky Honey Roast. But the owner suddenly had something to take care of and ended up asking me to keep an eye on the stall instead...

dialogues.speaker: Lietzberg
dialogues.text: So I'm filling in for now. Hopefully, he'll be back soon.
